activeSlice.scope: Bound Hunter shadow cohort screening when an explicit anchor Brand and disposable-anchor fallback are configured: screen only the targeted persisted Brand before fallback instead of running model preflights across unrelated persisted Brands. Preserve canonical readiness, control comparability, 3-Brand coverage, all rollout thresholds, and Hunter V1 production authority.
successCriteria: When an explicit anchor Brand and disposable persisted anchor are configured, operational cohort screening performs at most one persisted Brand control preflight before disposable fallback.
The explicitly targeted Brand workspace remains fail-closed and unambiguous.
If the targeted persisted Brand is Hunter-ready and comparable it may satisfy the mandatory persisted Brand slot; otherwise the existing disposable Vercel anchor path remains available.
Unrelated persisted Brands are not model-preflighted in targeted benchmark mode.
Ephemeral public Brands still satisfy canonical Hunter readiness and substantive V1 control comparability; no synthetic readiness bypass is introduced.
At least three distinct Brands and nine paired observations remain mandatory for pre-gate.
All rollout thresholds remain unchanged, including latency 1.5x, cost 1.5x, retrieval 0.85, failure 0.05, exploration 0.08-0.20, and maximum topic share 0.34.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
Corrected 3x3 pre-gate passes before any 30-pair full gate.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: Cohort construction exhausted model provider quota while screening persisted Brands before ephemeral public Brand bootstrap; Vercel and GitHub bootstrap returned 429.
